notes.title: Demo Update: QOL & Bug Fixing
notes.notes:
Hello UMAMI fans! 🥰

We are excited to announce some new updates for our cozy tasty puzzle game that we hope will make the demo even more fun and enjoyable!!
Thank you so much for your feedback and your messages! They're super helpful in making UMAMI even better, and we really appreciate that you took the time to share it with us 💜

Control improvements
We have added the two most requested features!

The ability to rotate AND zoom in/out the camera while you are holding a puzzle piece!
Without it, you had to pick up and let go of the piece to either zoom in, out, or turn the puzzle around, so it required a lot more clicking. Hopefully, this makes things a little easier and more comfortable!
You can now rotate the puzzle while holding a piece by using LMB + RMB. It allows you to easily get a look at every side of each puzzle while holding a piece.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/5384fdfbb2e21bbe8f98a036a3e2be2b451511d2.gif

The camera can now also zoom while holding pieces by using LMB + RMB + Mouse Wheel.
You can get up close or further to the puzzle while holding a piece, making it easier to evaluate their placement with precision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/d1235771ec4ec4555426daa192f7bb28ee86c011.gif

The camera no longer zooms with LMB + Mouse Wheel.
New Tutorial
We’ve also revamped the onboarding with a detailed tutorial to help with that first moment of “where do I begin?”. This includes short GIFs to visually explain the core interactions: how to control the camera, the pieces, where and how to place them.

Here’s a peek at the new tutorial: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/89f5e77a5d7e7629198e6c6f195c2b6277d03c47.png

Bug Fixing
We’ve also tackled a frustrating bug to keep your puzzles flowing smoothly:
Fixed an issue where pieces could get stuck inside the puzzle due to unintentional detachment from magnets, forcing a restart of the puzzle. Now, your pieces stay securely in place!
If you try out the updated demo, we’d love to hear your thoughts! 
Your feedback is incredibly valuable to me, so please don't forget to fill out the feedback form here: UMAMi Demo Feedback Form

Or, if you want to have a chat directly with us in the dev team, and exchange with other players, come join the Discord! 

Thank you for your continued support of UMAMI, and we hope that you enjoy these updates!
💛
